posts.author: NichnotFound
posts.body:
Hello hello! My name is Nich and i'm doing a pretty big RPG Maker MV Game. Anyways, i wanted to make the battles in this game more dynamic and engaging, so i had an idea to mess with the camera during the combat, but had no idea how. Anyone could help me out?
So, this is the battle screen (for now). I want to change the actors position and size later, so the camera thing works better. Now, i'll explain how i want the camera to work:
It is the 1st actor's turn (the red guy), so the camera zooms into him. When the player chooses an action, the camera smoothly moves to the second actor, and so goes on until the player chooses the action for all four actors. Then, when the player's turn is done, the camera should zoom out to the distance it is in the picture. The actors and enemies would do their actions like normal, and once it is the player's turn again, the cycle repeats.
Is this possible in anyway? If it should be an entirely new plugin, i have a programmer in my team, they can code this for me, but i fear it isn't even possible, and i wanted to try and do something before asking for him to do it.. So, any advice or something? Thanks for reading!

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
NichnotFound said:
i fear it isn't even possible

Almost anything is possible. Obviously, things vary in difficulty. I'm not sure how difficult this request would be, though. It might actually be very easy, if just applying a straight 2D zoom to the entire screen works for your purposes (and is simple to do in the rendering system, but I doubt that would be an issue). But from your description, I fear a simple 2D zoom likely wouldn't be satisfactory. It sounds like you want a
3D
zoom; doing that in 2D would mean dealing with complex parallax effects, and doing it in 3D would be scrapping the most of rendering engine and starting anew.
But in any case it's not really something you can do with an event, unless you go heavy on script calls, which means a plugin is really the better choice here. I suggest you ask your programmer!

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
Oh, to be clear, I meant "very easy for a programmer who's writing a plugin to do it". I didn't mean to imply that you could do it with an event or anything.
The test for whether it works for your purpose would be: take a screenshot of your battle, and scale it up, then crop the result to the same size as the original. The actual method is: write code to do that dynamically in the engine. It can definitely be smooth; the real question is whether it'll even look good, since it's just scaling up what you already have.
